lines: Danish Scholarship 2024-25 Last Date to Apply - 10 April 2025

was set up in March 2006 in Bangalore. It was mainly with the aim of identifying talented youth and taking care of their basic economic needs in order to enable them to fully devote their attention towards attainment of education and building of personality. Danish Educational Trust (R) gives scholarships to students (boys & girls) pursuing Engineering, Medicine, Law, Journalism, Nursing, Allied Health, Veterinary Sciences, Agriculture Sciences, Education and Civil Services.

For Muslim Students (Boys & Girls) who have taken admission to 1st year for Academic Year 2024-2025 in following Professional Courses – BE/B.Tech, B.Arch, MBBS, BUMS, BAMS, BHMS, B.V.Sc, BSc Agriculture, B.Sc Forestry, B.Pharma, Pharm D, BSc Nursing, BDS (Dental), BPT (Physiotherapy) & B.Sc (Allied Health) on merit basis through NEET 2024 & K-CET 2024 Counselling only.

For students who have taken admission to 1st year for Academic Year 2024-2025 in Law Courses (BA LLB, BBA LLB, BCom LLB & LLM), Journalism Courses - BA (Journalism), MA / MS (Journalism / Mass Communication), Education Courses (BA B.Ed / BSc B.Ed / B.Ed).
Students who have taken admission to 2nd Year BE (Lateral Entry) through KCET 2024 after completing 3 years Diploma can apply.

For Financial Year 2024-2025, Rs. 1 Crore 70 lakhs have been earmarked to support 650+ students who will be selected across Karnataka for the Scholarship based on merit & financial background of the student.
Danish Professional Scholarship is a One time Scholarship Only. The scholarship amount is as follows.
For BDS, BAMS, BHMS, BUMS - Rs.30,000/-
For BVSc, B.Sc Agriculture, B.Sc Forestry - Rs.20,000/-
For BSc Nursing, B.Pharma, Pharm D, BPT (Physiotherapy) & B.Sc Allied Health - Rs.20,000/-
For BA B.Ed, BSc B.Ed, B.Ed Courses - Rs.15,000/-
Note : Danish Educational Trust can increase / decrease the amount of scholarship depending on the number of applications. The Decision of Danish Educational Trust Selection Committee is Final
